Oil vs Water

CBD for Inflammation & Recovery Products

For inflammation and muscle recovery, water-based CBD products are often preferred over oil-based ones. The water-based formulations work with your body, which is made mostly of water, instead of against it like oil-based formulations do. This means more rapid absorption and quicker alleviation of inflammation and muscle recovery. The higher bioavailability of water-based CBD means the body utilizes the compound more effectively, enhancing its anti-inflammatory and recovery properties.

  • Faster absorption for quicker inflammation relief
  • Enhanced bioavailability for superior muscle recovery
  • Combine with other powerful anti-inflammatories like curcumin

Opting for water-based CBD products ensures a more effective approach to managing inflammation and post-workout muscle strain.

settings.title: How does CBD help with recovery?
settings.text: CBD may help with recovery by potentially reducing inflammation and supporting the body's natural healing processes. Some individuals have reported that CBD, particularly when combined with other anti-inflammatory ingredients like Curcumin, can help alleviate exercise-induced muscle soreness and promote faster recovery. However, more research is needed, and individual responses may vary. If you're considering using CBD for recovery, it's advisable to consult with a healthcare professional for personalized advice. NextEvo Naturals is committed to providing high-quality CBD products that can potentially support overall wellness and recovery.

settings.title: Can I use CBD recovery cream alongside other CBD products?
settings.text: Yes, you can use CBD cream with other products such as capsules, gummies and powder. But start with small amounts and build up gradually until you find the right levels for your body, and don’t exceed the recommended dosage.

settings.title: Can CBD help a pulled muscle?
settings.text: CBD may have potential benefits for relieving pulled muscle pain. CBD has demonstrated anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties, which can help reduce pain associated with inflammation due to muscle injuries. Additionally, CBD's interaction with the endocannabinoid system may contribute to muscle relaxation. However, more research is needed to fully understand CBD's effects on muscle injuries. It's recommended to consult with a healthcare professional before using CBD to address a pulled muscle.

settings.title: Does CBD actually help muscle soreness?
settings.text: CBD has shown potential in alleviating muscle soreness, primarily due to its anti-inflammatory properties. Several studies have suggested that CBD may help reduce inflammation, which can contribute to muscle soreness and discomfort. However, individual responses to CBD may vary, and it's important to consider factors such as dosage, frequency of use, and personal circumstances. If you're experiencing muscle soreness, we recommend consulting with a healthcare professional to discuss whether CBD may be suitable for you and to determine the best approach for addressing your specific needs.

settings.title: When should I take CBD for recovery?
settings.text: CBD for recovery, especially after physical activity or exercise, can be taken immediately post-workout or in the evening. Taking CBD post-workout can help reduce inflammation and muscle soreness, aiding in recovery. For more prolonged effects, such as improving sleep quality and overall recovery during rest, taking CBD in the evening can be beneficial. As CBD needs time to interact with your body, consistent use over several weeks is recommended for the best results.
